scope: 12 independent phone steps, each with real interface capture or explicitly labelled official historical app screen. Entry views are distinguished from downstream forms and transaction receipts.

steps.title: Open Join CSSBuy on your phone
steps.titleZh: 在手机上打开 Join CSSBuy
actions: Open this site in Safari or Chrome. Tap the visible Join CSSBuy button beside the currency control; the button below opens the same registration link.
Complete registration on CSSBuy and keep that account for the later order and warehouse stages. If a chat app opens an embedded browser, use its menu to open the page in your normal browser.
actionsZh: 在 Safari 或 Chrome 中打开本站，点击货币选项旁直接显示的 Join CSSBuy 按钮；下方按钮也会打开相同注册链接。
在 CSSBuy 完成注册，后续采购和仓库操作都使用该账号。如在聊天软件内打开，可通过其菜单转到系统浏览器。
steps.check: The registration page is CSSBuy. Registration is not a product order.
steps.checkZh: 确认当前为 CSSBuy 注册页面；注册不等于下单。
steps.imageTitle: Find the Join CSSBuy registration button
steps.imageTitleZh: 找到 Join CSSBuy 注册按钮
steps.imageAction: Tap the green Join CSSBuy button (加入 CSSBuy in this earlier capture). The current header shows Join CSSBuy directly beside the currency control. The registration form opens on CSSBuy.
steps.imageActionZh: 点击绿色 Join CSSBuy 按钮（此历史截图中显示为“加入 CSSBuy”）。当前页头直接在货币选项旁显示该按钮，注册表单将在 CSSBuy 打开。
steps.imageCaption: Earlier CSSBuy VIP phone browser capture · Chinese display example. The current header exposes the registration button directly. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: 本站早期手机浏览器截图 · 中文显示示例；当前页头已直接显示注册按钮。点击查看原图。

steps.title: Find the item with touch controls
steps.titleZh: 用手机搜索并查看商品
actions: Tap Spreadsheet in the menu, or enter the item name or exact Weidian item ID in the search box and tap Search.
Tap the product card. On the detail page, tap thumbnails and style photos; open a photo to inspect it closely. Scroll to the reference QC at the bottom.
Keep this detail page open in a browser tab so you can compare it with the CSSBuy listing.
actionsZh: 点击菜单中的 Spreadsheet，或在搜索框输入商品名、完整微店商品 ID 后点击 Search。
点击商品卡片进入详情页；点缩略图切换款式，打开图片查看细节，再向下查看底部的参考 QC。
保留这个商品详情页的浏览器标签，方便与 CSSBuy 商品页面对照。
steps.check: The item ID and selected style match the find you intended to buy. Reference QC is not your own order QC.
steps.checkZh: 核对商品 ID 和预期款式；参考 QC 不代表自己的订单质检。
steps.imageTitle: Search an exact item ID, then open the result
steps.imageTitleZh: 输入完整商品 ID，再打开结果
steps.imageAction: Enter 7875678297 and tap Search (搜索). The result count shows one matching item; tap its product card below.
steps.imageActionZh: 输入 7875678297 并点击 Search（搜索），确认结果是对应商品，再点下方卡片。
steps.imageCaption: CSSBuy VIP phone browser capture · Chinese display example. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: CSSBuy VIP 手机浏览器实拍 · 中文显示示例，点击放大。

steps.title: Open the same item on CSSBuy
steps.titleZh: 在手机上打开 CSSBuy 同款页面
steps.whereZh: 商品详情 · Buy on CSSBuy
actions: Tap Buy on CSSBuy on the product detail page. The outgoing link keeps that product’s item ID and this site’s promotion parameter.
In the new CSSBuy browser tab, check the item title, seller and item ID. Tap the size and colour options; do not assume a style selected on this directory is already selected on CSSBuy.
After signing in, return to the same item page if CSSBuy sends you to its homepage.
actionsZh: 在商品详情页点击 Buy on CSSBuy，链接会携带该商品 ID 和本站推广参数。
在新打开的 CSSBuy 浏览器标签里核对标题、卖家和商品 ID，重新点击尺码、颜色选项；本站看过的款式不会自动替你在 CSSBuy 选中。
登录后如回到 CSSBuy 首页，请返回原来的同款商品标签。
steps.check: Check the current variant price and quantity before continuing.
steps.checkZh: 继续前核对当前规格价格与数量。
steps.imageTitleZh: 点击同款 CSSBuy 购买按钮
steps.imageAction: Inspect the style thumbnails, then tap Buy on CSSBuy (在 CSSBuy 上购买). Confirm size and colour again on CSSBuy; the directory does not select them for you.
steps.imageActionZh: 查看款式缩略图后，点击 Buy on CSSBuy（在 CSSBuy 上购买）；到 CSSBuy 后仍需重新确认尺码和颜色。
steps.imageCaption: CSSBuy VIP phone browser capture · Chinese display example. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: CSSBuy VIP 手机浏览器实拍 · 中文显示示例，点击放大。

steps.title: Know the phone app’s navigation
steps.titleZh: 认清手机应用里的入口
steps.whereZh: 可选 CSSBuy 应用 · Home / Account
actions: You can continue in the mobile browser. If you already use the official CSSBuy app, sign in with the same account; the app examples below are separate from the browser interface.
In this official historical app example, Home is at the bottom left and Account is at the bottom right. The search field accepts a keyword or URL.
Use Account for your own orders and warehouse records. Do not create a second account just to switch devices.
actionsZh: 可以继续用手机浏览器。如果已使用官方 CSSBuy 应用，请登录同一个账号；下方应用示例与手机网页是不同界面。
这张官方历史应用图的底部左侧是 Home，右侧是 Account；顶部输入框可输入关键词或链接。
通过 Account 查看自己的订单和仓库记录，不需要为了换设备重新注册。
steps.check: The app and browser use the same account; current app labels may differ from the historical example.
steps.checkZh: 确认应用与浏览器登录同一个账号；当前版本入口名称可能变化。
steps.imageTitle: Home, search and the bottom navigation
steps.imageTitleZh: 首页搜索框与底部导航
steps.imageAction: Find the search field at the top and the Home / Account tabs along the bottom. This is an official app interface example, not the CSSBuy mobile website.
steps.imageActionZh: 先认清顶部搜索框和底部 Home / Account。这是官方应用界面示例，不是 CSSBuy 手机网页。
steps.imageCaption: Official CSSBuy historical phone app example. Current labels can differ. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: CSSBuy 官方历史手机应用界面示例，当前入口可能变化，点击放大。

steps.title: Estimate shipping before buying
steps.whereZh: CSSBuy 应用 · Cost Estimate 示例
actions: Open the shipping estimate tool on CSSBuy. In the app example, select the destination, enter a realistic weight and, when available, parcel dimensions.
Tap the restrictions that apply to the goods, then tap Estimate. An estimate without the right destination or restrictions may show unsuitable routes.
Keep the estimate separate from the final warehouse parcel quote: packing size and measured weight can change the charge.
actionsZh: 打开 CSSBuy 运费估算工具。按应用示例选择目的地，填写合理的重量；已知包裹尺寸时再填写长宽高。
点击与商品相符的限制类型，再点 Estimate；目的地或限制条件错误，可能显示不适用的线路。
估算与入库后的最终包裹报价分开看，包装尺寸和实测重量都会影响费用。
steps.check: An estimate is not a reserved route or a paid shipping label.
steps.checkZh: 估算结果不代表已经预订线路或支付运费。
steps.imageAction: Read the destination, weight, dimensions and restrictions fields, then the Estimate button. The publisher’s example values are illustrative.
steps.imageActionZh: 依次查看目的地、重量、尺寸、限制选项和 Estimate 按钮；图中数值仅为官方示例。
steps.imageCaption: Official CSSBuy historical phone app example. Current labels can differ. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: CSSBuy 官方历史手机应用界面示例，当前入口可能变化，点击放大。

steps.title: Confirm options and the first payment
steps.titleZh: 核对规格并支付第一笔采购费用
actions: On the live CSSBuy product page, choose the size, colour and quantity, add any necessary purchase note, and review the checkout summary.
Review the item price, seller’s delivery fee and selected services. Read the final total before authorizing payment.
If CSSBuy asks you to recharge first, use a currently offered method and return to the order afterwards. A balance top-up alone does not confirm that a product order was placed.
actionsZh: 在 CSSBuy 当前商品页选择尺码、颜色、数量，填写必要备注，再核对结算摘要。
查看商品价、卖家运费及已勾选服务，确认最终总额后再自行支付。
如要求先充值，请使用当前提供的方式，充值后返回订单继续；余额充值成功不等于商品已经下单。
steps.check: Verify an actual order record after paying. Do not treat this recharge illustration as an order confirmation or a list of guaranteed payment methods.
steps.checkZh: 付款后查看实际订单记录；这张充值图不是下单成功页，也不保证图中每种方式当前均可用。
steps.imageTitle: Identify the recharge stage before completing the order
steps.imageTitleZh: 辨认充值页面，再返回完成订单
steps.imageAction: This mobile Recharge example shows the funding stage. Choose only a method offered on the live page, then return to the product order. This image is not a checkout receipt.
steps.imageActionZh: 这张手机 Recharge 示例展示充值阶段；使用当前实际可用的方式，之后返回商品订单继续。配图不是结算成功凭证。
steps.imageCaption: Official CSSBuy historical phone app example. Current labels can differ. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: CSSBuy 官方历史手机应用界面示例，当前入口可能变化，点击放大。

steps.title: Follow the order from your phone
steps.titleZh: 在手机里查看采购进度
actions: Open your account’s order list. Locate the item by its order number or title instead of relying only on the photo.
The official app example includes All, Unpaid, Processing and In Warehouse tabs. Read the status on your own record before taking action.
Processing is not the same as In Warehouse. Wait for the actual received status before trying to submit an international parcel.
actionsZh: 进入账号订单列表，通过订单编号或标题找到商品，不要只凭缩略图判断。
官方应用示例有 All、Unpaid、Processing、In Warehouse 等标签，以自己订单的实际状态为准。
Processing 不等于 In Warehouse；商品实际入库后才进入国际包裹提交阶段。
steps.check: Your own order status and selected variant are correct. This publisher screenshot shows an example order, not your purchase.
steps.checkZh: 核对自己的订单状态和规格；官方图中的订单仅是示例。
steps.imageTitle: Read the status of the matching order
steps.imageAction: Read the status tabs and the In Warehouse badge. An item still in Processing is not yet a received warehouse item.
steps.imageActionZh: 查看订单状态标签和 In Warehouse 标记；Processing 的商品仍未完成入库。
steps.imageCaption: Official CSSBuy historical phone app example. Current labels can differ. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: CSSBuy 官方历史手机应用界面示例，当前入口可能变化，点击放大。

steps.title: Open your own QC photos
steps.titleZh: 打开自己的 QC 照片
steps.whereZh: CSSBuy 应用 · 订单 Photo 入口
actions: On the matching warehouse order, open its photo action. In the official order-card example above, the control is labelled Photo.
Open each received photo on the phone and zoom in to inspect the size label, colour, stitching, condition and included accessories. Compare with the exact ordered variant.
If something is wrong, contact support from that same order before submitting the parcel. Ask about the applicable return window and any extra photos you need.
actionsZh: 在对应的入库订单里打开照片入口；上一张官方订单卡片示例中，该按钮叫 Photo。
在手机上逐张打开并放大实收照片，检查尺码标、颜色、做工、状态和配件，与已下单规格对照。
有问题先从该订单联系支持，再决定是否提交包裹；同时确认适用退换期限及需要补拍的细节。
steps.check: Use the QC attached to your own order, not the reference photos in this directory.
steps.checkZh: 使用自己订单下的 QC，不要把本站参考照片当作本次订单质检。
steps.imageTitle: Tap Photo on your received order
steps.imageTitleZh: 在已入库订单上点击 Photo
steps.imageAction: Find the exact order and tap Photo. This screenshot demonstrates the real photo-entry button; your own QC images open after that tap.
steps.imageActionZh: 找到对应订单，再点 Photo。配图展示实际照片入口，点击后才会打开自己的 QC 照片。
steps.imageCaption: Official historical app · Photo entry shown, not an opened QC viewer. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: 官方历史应用 · 配图为 Photo 照片入口，不是已打开的 QC 查看页，点击放大。

steps.title: Select received items for one parcel
steps.titleZh: 在手机里选择要合箱的入库商品
actions: Open the warehouse or received-items list for your account. Select only the goods you want in this shipment.
Check every selected row, quantity and variant before continuing. On a small screen, scroll through the whole selection to catch items below the fold.
If an item is still being processed, or you are waiting for a QC answer, leave it out of this parcel.
actionsZh: 进入账号仓库或已入库商品列表，只勾选本次准备寄出的商品。
逐行核对勾选商品、数量和规格；手机屏幕较小，需要滚到列表底部检查有没有误选。
还在采购处理、或正在等待 QC 答复的商品，先不要加入本次包裹。
steps.check: Only the intended received items are selected; review the complete live selection before submitting.
steps.checkZh: 只勾选本次要寄出的已入库商品，提交前检查完整勾选清单。
steps.imageTitle: Select a received item from its order card
steps.imageTitleZh: 从订单卡片勾选已入库商品
steps.imageAction: Check the In Warehouse badge first, then select the circle beside Orders. Continue to parcel submission on the live page after reviewing all selected items.
steps.imageActionZh: 先核对 In Warehouse 状态，再点 Orders 左侧选择圆圈；检查全部勾选商品后，在实际页面继续提交包裹。
steps.imageCaption: Official historical app · Item-selection control shown. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: 官方历史应用 · 配图展示商品勾选控件，点击放大。

steps.title: Check the full address on the phone form
steps.titleZh: 在手机表单中核对完整收件地址
actions: On the parcel destination form, choose or add the recipient address. Verify the name, destination, region, city, postal code, street and any unit number.
Check the telephone country code and number. Close the keyboard, then scroll back through all fields so you can see values hidden below it.
Save the address and confirm the selected address in the parcel summary; an address saved to the account is not necessarily the one selected for this shipment.
actionsZh: 在包裹收件地址表单中选择或新增地址，核对姓名、目的地、州省、城市、邮编、街道和门牌或公寓号。
核对电话区号和号码；收起键盘后再滚动检查所有字段，避免漏看被键盘遮住的内容。
保存后回到包裹摘要确认实际选中的地址；账号里保存了地址不代表本次包裹已选用。
steps.check: The full address selected in the parcel summary is correct, including postal code and telephone country code.
steps.checkZh: 包裹摘要中的实际地址、邮编和电话区号均正确。
steps.imageTitle: Edit and check the parcel address
steps.imageTitleZh: 点击 Edit，核对包裹收件地址
steps.imageAction: Tap Edit beside Delivery address, save your full address, then check the selected address here. The publisher’s example name, phone and address values have been redacted.
steps.imageActionZh: 点击 Delivery address 右侧的 Edit，保存完整收件地址后，再回到这里核对实际选中地址。官方示例中的姓名、电话和地址值已遮挡。
steps.imageCaption: Official CSSBuy historical phone app example. Current labels can differ. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: CSSBuy 官方历史手机应用界面示例，当前入口可能变化，点击放大。

steps.title: Choose the route and pay international shipping
steps.titleZh: 选择线路并确认国际运费
actions: Compare the routes actually offered for the selected destination and goods. Review weight rules, size limits, restrictions and the quoted charge.
Choose the required packing options. Scroll to the bottom of the phone form to review service selections and the final total before submitting.
Follow CSSBuy’s actual quote and payment instructions. If the measured parcel price changes, review the new amount rather than relying on the earlier estimate.
actionsZh: 比较当前目的地和商品实际可用的线路，查看计重方式、尺寸限制、货物限制和报价。
选择所需包装；在手机表单中滚到底部，再次核对服务勾选和最终总额。
按照 CSSBuy 实际报价与付款提示操作；如实测后费用变化，重新核对金额，不沿用之前估算。
steps.check: International shipping is a separate payment stage. Confirm the current route, selected services and actual total before authorizing payment.
steps.checkZh: 国际运费与商品采购分开支付，自行付款前核对当前线路、所选服务和实际总额。
steps.imageTitle: Edit the shipping method and review the payable total
steps.imageTitleZh: 选择 Shipping method，再核对待付金额
steps.imageAction: Tap Edit beside Shipping method. Review the available route and packing options, then check the total beside Pay now. This is a historical submission form, not proof of payment.
steps.imageActionZh: 点击 Shipping method 右侧 Edit，核对可用线路与包装选项，再查看 Pay now 旁的总额。这是历史提交表单，不是付款成功凭证。
steps.imageCaption: Official CSSBuy historical phone app example. Current labels can differ. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: CSSBuy 官方历史手机应用界面示例，当前入口可能变化，点击放大。

steps.title: Track the parcel and ask about a specific order
steps.titleZh: 在手机里追踪包裹并联系订单支持
actions: After CSSBuy creates the parcel record, open your parcel list and select the matching parcel number to view its current tracking information.
For an item issue, return to the matching order’s Contact support action. Include the order number and a clear description; keep the reply with that order.
For a parcel issue, include the parcel number instead. A product’s seller-delivery tracking is different from the later international parcel tracking.
actionsZh: CSSBuy 生成包裹记录后，进入包裹列表，按对应包裹编号查看当前物流信息。
商品问题从对应订单的 Contact support 入口询问，写清订单编号和问题，并保留回复记录。
包裹问题提供包裹编号；卖家发往仓库的物流，与之后的国际包裹物流是不同记录。
steps.check: Keep the item order number and international parcel number separate when checking tracking or asking support.
steps.checkZh: 查询物流或联系支持时，区分商品订单编号与国际包裹编号。
steps.imageTitle: Use Track or Contact support on the correct record
steps.imageTitleZh: 从对应记录打开 Track 或 Contact support
steps.imageAction: The order card has Track and Contact support buttons. Track on an item can refer to seller-to-warehouse movement; for international delivery, open the separate parcel record.
steps.imageActionZh: 订单卡片上有 Track 和 Contact support；商品订单上的 Track 可能指卖家到仓库的物流，国际运输应查看独立包裹记录。
steps.imageCaption: Official historical app · Tracking and support entry buttons, not a delivery confirmation. Open to enlarge.
steps.imageCaptionZh: 官方历史应用 · 配图为物流与客服入口，不是签收确认页，点击放大。
